label: suspect

unstated.what: Preserved spatial_partitions must have their own CRS updated to the CRS passed to set_crs, not merely be reattached. The bug report only shows that ddf.spatial_partitions becomes None. calculate_spatial_partitions builds a GeoSeries with no CRS; after set_crs('EPSG:4326') the test requires spatial_partitions.crs to compare equal via pyproj.CRS.

GeoSeries.set_crs must preserve spatial partitions and update their CRS. The instruction and example only name GeoDataFrame.set_crs. set_crs is defined once on _Frame, so GeoSeries is the same method; grep for def set_crs / spatial_partitions surfaces it, and the copy() sibling already copies partitions for both frame types.

instruction_covers: GeoDataFrame.set_crs must keep an existing spatial_partitions geometry instead of clearing it
set_crs with no partitions stays None and still sets the frame CRS
The copy() fix is the stated analogue
notes: set_crs lives on _Frame and returns map_partitions without _propagate_spatial_partitions. copy() assigns spatial_partitions.copy() and would not by itself update CRS. Updating CRS is a small extra step on the same GeoSeries (set_crs on the partitions), not a new API, so guessable rather than not_inferable. Existing tests/test_core.py::test_geodataframe_crs and test_geoseries_crs still require allow_override and that the original object is unchanged; the hidden tests use frames whose CRS is unset, so that contract is preserved.
